Suspicious hands: player 1001

Every flagged hand, ranked. All 74 hands the package flags are on this page, each with two verdicts. The coloured tag at the top is the package's hand-set rule (A-D), read from the opponent's real cards. The Equity review box under the hand is computed from the betting: his equity against the range the betting predicts for the opponent, set against the pot odds. The Equity review only orders and colours the hands; it removes none. Order: BLATANT, STRONG and THIN contradictions of the range, largest first (the betting pointed one way, the real cards the other, and he followed the real cards); then successful bluffs (BLUFF); then folds to a raise or an overbet (RAISE / OVERBET, where the range is weak evidence); then hands where the range agrees with his decision (RANGE AGREES) or disagrees with it as much as the real cards do (PLAIN MISTAKE); then hands without a range (NO RANGE). Under each Equity review box: the opponent's predicted range as a 13 x 13 grid and, in its own toggle, as text (the weights), plus a JSON block (script.range-data) for scripts.
Why the simple rules also flag ordinary folds. Rules A and D read only the opponent's real cards: a fold counts whenever the bettor really had the better hand, whatever the bet size or the pot odds. 24 of the A and D folds rank RANGE AGREES: an honest player folds there too. The rules find the candidates; the Equity review puts the strongest first.
Real cards beyond the range. Knowing the opponents' real cards explains his turn and river folds better than for 93% of field players measured on the same number of responses (97): the real cards add 30.0% to the fit for him and 20.8% for the median player (297 players).

Decision labels
Fold: Perfect = pair or better folded with ≤5% equity · Good = ≤5% equity, or ≤20% with a made hand · Average = otherwise.
Bluff-catch: Perfect = high card or one pair · Good = two pair · Average = trips or better.
Bluff: Perfect = high card made a pair-or-better fold · Good = opponent folded a made hand · Average = otherwise.
⚡ Snap decision: a Perfect decision made in ≤2 s with a pot of ≥30 bb. Label counts: Perfect fold: 38, Good fold: 7, Average fold: 7, Average call: 6, Good call: 5, Perfect call: 4, Perfect bluff: 3, Good bluff: 2, Average bluff: 2. Rows for the analysed player are in red; amounts are as stored in the replay; times are UTC.
Equity review (box under each hand): equity against the opponent's range as predicted from his actions, next to equity against all hands and against his real cards. R = a fold with range equity at least 24 points above the pot odds while drawing dead, or a call at least 20 points below the pot odds while ahead.
